build_QINCo_quantizer: build a QINCo quantizer model with d dimensions, K codebook size, L residual blocks, M steps, and h hidden size
encode_QINCo: encode a batch of vectors into discrete codes using the QINCo quantizer model
decode_QINCo: decode discrete codes back into reconstructed vectors using the QINCo quantizer model
build_PQ_QINCo: build a Product Quantization QINCo model with sub-quantizers and optional OPQ rotation matrix
build_IVF_QINCo: build an IVF-QINCo quantizer with a frozen IVF codebook followed by M quantization steps
